c2.messageHeadline: Make hostless HTTP(S) URLs fail resolution and cleaning (#2579)
c2.message:
Make hostless HTTP(S) URLs fail resolution and cleaning (#2579)

HTTP and HTTPS resolution now rejects results without a host in
accordance with RFC 9110.

The Safelist fallback preserves custom URI schemes without reviving
malformed HTTP(S) values.

nodes.title: Make hostless HTTP(S) URLs fail resolution and cleaning

c4.messageHeadline: Escape supplementary characters for non-UTF charsets
c4.message:
Escape supplementary characters for non-UTF charsets

Supplementary characters are now checked as complete code points before being emitted with non-UTF, non-ASCII charsets.

The previous low-16-bit check could treat U+100A3 as U+00A3 under ISO-8859-1, then emit the original character unchanged.

This still preserves the existing ASCII and UTF fast paths.

c5.messageHeadline: Align text-state tokenization with the HTML spec (#2577)
c5.message:
Align text-state tokenization with the HTML spec (#2577)

This aligns RCDATA, RAWTEXT, and script-data end-tag handling with the
HTML5 spec, including malformed-input recovery and EOF behavior.

It removes the RCDATA lookahead workaround for #83 and lets the text
states share one simpler parsing path, while preserving exact matching
for configured custom text tags.

nodes.title: Align text-state tokenization with the HTML spec
